question_text: Were all secondary financing requirements met?

applicability.source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Loans.LoanID FROM Loans  WHERE  Loans.QC_Policy = 'Fannie Mae'

defect_options.response: Subordinate financing was allowed on a Co-op share loan without obtaining a policy exception

finding.description: Subordinate financing was allowed on a Co-op share loan without obtaining a policy exception.

defect_options.response: Subordinate lien not evidenced by a note, recorded mtg, &/or not clearly subordinate to 1st mtg lien

finding.description: The subordinate lien was not evidenced by a promissory note, recorded security instrument, and/or is not clearly subordinate to the first mortgage lien.

defect_options.response: All re-subordination requirements were not met for refinance transactions

finding.description: All re-subordination requirements were not met for refinance transactions.

defect_options.response: The type/terms of subordinate financing unacceptable

finding.description: The type or the terms of the subordinate financing are unacceptable as per FNMA guidelines.

citations.title: Loan Eligibility for Co-op Share Loans

question_text: Were all business account asset requirements met?

applicability.source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Loans.LoanID FROM Loans  WHERE  Loans.QC_Policy = 'Fannie Mae'

defect_options.response: Business assets used as down payment, closing costs or reserves & a cash flow analysis not completed

finding.description: Business assets are used for down payment, closing costs or reserves, a business cash flow analysis to confirm the withdrawal of funds will not have a negative impact on the business not provided.

defect_options.response: Business assets used as assets to close and the borrower is not listed as an owner of the account

finding.description: Business assets were used as available assets to close and the borrower is not listed as an owner of the account.

defect_options.response: File did not document that withdrawal of business assets will not be detrimental to the business

finding.description: Business assets were used as available assets to close, and a written analysis is not in the file to determine that the withdrawal of the funds will not have a detrimental effect on the business.

citations.title: Underwriting Factors and Documentation for a Self-Employed Borrower
